S5 E14 — The One Where Everybody Finds OutRoss rents an apartment with a window facing Monica and Rachel's place. While checking out the apartment, Phoebe sees Monica and Chandler having sex and learns the truth.
S5 E15 — The One With The Girl Who Hits JoeyJoey dates a girl who likes to playfully punch him. Ross makes enemies out of his new neighbours. Chandler freaks out about his relationship with Monica.
S5 E16 — The One With The CopAfter Phoebe finds a police badge, she uses it to do good deeds. Joey has a dream about Monica and becomes convinced he is in love with her.

S5 E17 — The One With Rachel's Inadvertent KissRachel accidentally kisses the man interviewing her for a job. Joey becomes obsessed with a woman living in Ross' apartment complex. Monica becomes jealous of Phoebe and Gary.

Chris finally has a weekend off vet duties and is heading to Newcastle to catch up with his parents. But a call from his dad about a bizarre snake emergency sends him on a fascinating detour.

A game of chasey at home turns ugly for Hooligan when he runs into his owner, Sarah. Hooligan's horribly fractured leg needs major surgery at Sash, but the tiny terrier has never spent a night away from his family and is not coping.
Chris is confronted with the smallest patient he has ever handled. A young girl's much-loved pet mouse, Pinot has developed a massive tumour. But surgery on such a small patient is a challenge.

Homer the turtle is going on holidays while his owner is overseas. What can go wrong? Well try finding the little fellow in the fangs of the resident pooch. Babysitter Jody is guilt ridden and the traumatised Homer is the victim of a big bacteria bite. Can Chris save the day for everyone?

Chris heads to the Victorian high country to help out a mate and to realise a boyhood dream of becoming a vet in the bush. It’s a challenging week as he treats everything from horses to wombats and monkeys and helps save a mother in trouble. Monkeys carry some nasty diseases and watch for Chris’ concerns about what he might leave Mansfield with. Talk about a dangerous job.

Observe as Chris treats Pearl, a poodle that began bleeding internally at the groomer, while surgeons try to save Zoe, a cat that dove off a second-floor balcony. Meanwhile, the clinic gets a special gift from a grateful patient.

Join the team’s 24-hour vigil for Lucu, a pup that’s been bitten by a tick. Then check out Jonti, a cat with a gaping hole in his neck that’s scarily close to his jugular vein—all while Chris tangles with an evasive lame emu.
A bizarre looking baby cockatoo has fallen twenty metres out of her nest and wants to alert the whole world to her plight. Can Chris help the little screamer? And will she ever be able to fly?

Chris fights to save one of the clinic’s favorite patients. Beautiful Bluebell was dumped on the doorstep of the clinic as a kitten and adopted out to a loving family. Now he is the victim of a hit run accident.

Andrew investigates a worrying lump on a horse for a possible killer disease, but can he get close enough to find out? And Doctor Rachel is feeling the pressure when a passionate wildlife warrior brings in two distressed little Aussies.
Romi faces multiple emergencies when Lucy the groodle crashes before and during surgery, and Andrew treats a seriously ill goat that could be infested with a life-threatening parasite.

Andrew must make a life-and-death decision on a close friend’s pet cow. Rachel investigates why a friendly young Labrador has developed a worrying limp, but can she calm her terrified patient down enough to even treat him?

On this episode, a critically ill kangaroo infant has Andrew and the young joey’s rescuer worried for its life. Dr. Romi has her hands full with eight lively puppies, but will they get a clean bill of health?
On this episode, delicate surgery has Andrew anxious for Sally the cow’s future. And why is Doctor Romi so over the moon?

Nearly six years of our lives are spent dreaming. Yet there is so much untapped creative potential in our dreams. What if we could take the brilliant ideas from our dreams and turn them into reality? How can we make our dreams more meaningful?

No one lives forever, but scientists will never stop trying to combat aging. Now, laboratories around the world have been successful with rejuvenation in animals such as mice and fruit flies. If animals are living longer and healthier lives, can this research benefit humans?

The story of the Antonov An-225, a relic of the cold war era aircraft made in the Ukraine that still flies challenging missions today. It is the biggest airplane in the world and holds the most air records for cargo lift.

While the graphic art of Ancient Egypt is very familiar, little is known about the artists and scribes. Who were they? How important were they to the Pharaohs? From Saqqara to the Valley of Kings, explore the lives of our first historians on record.

It took a long time for vertebrates to really take over the land, but once they did, there was no turning back. Reptiles seemed to win the race, some becoming the biggest creatures to ever walk the Earth. Dinosaurs dominated for 150 million years, but they weren't alone.

Ice is the deadliest enemy. Former soldier and archaeologist Ben Timberlake is on a mission to reveal the ice's role in wars past, present, and future. From hunting lost WW1 bunkers in Italy, to secret Cold War nuclear bases in Greenland's ice, to modern-day Arctic espionage on Russia's border.
The sun is the biggest source of energy in the solar system. Innovators are searching for new ways to capture more of the sun's power, and make it available through the night, everywhere.
Three motorsport drivers from different backgrounds chase their dreams of winning a professional championship.
Mexican driver Juan Carlos Blum makes his ARCA Racing Series debut; Dominican drifting champion Jhonnattan Castro faces U.S. competition.

Juan Carlos has his best race to date; Jhonnattan aims to compete in a Formula Drift main event; Brian faces adversity at his home track.
Jhonnattan finally achieves success; Brian hangs out with NHRA Funny Car champion John Force at the U.S. Nationals; Juan Carlos travels to Illinois to prove his skill.
Juan Carlos demonstrates his skill at high speeds; Jhonnattan returns home; Brian struggles with low finances and Mother Nature; disabled racer Brandon Winfield chases his dreams.
Disabled go-kart racer Brandon Winfield attempts to join the TS Racing team; Jhonnattan aims for success on the Formula Drift circuit; Juan Carlos makes his NASCAR debut.
Juan Carlos races at Texas Motor Speedway; Jhonnattan searches for luck in Las Vegas; Brandon drives a new customized go-kart.

When Sig loses GPS navigation in crowded waters, Mandy must work a decades-old magnetic compass with no margin for error. OJ's replacement on the Wizard makes a misfit crew a bit more awkward. Bob's Bairdi haul earns her bragging rights and breakdowns.

On the Time Bandit, crew conflict in winter weather puts Johnathan's leadership to the test. Sig and Mandy risk a heavy fine chasing the biomass along a boundary line. Jake struggles with managing an injury-prone crew member hellbent on earning his share.

As a monumental king tide amplifies the sea state, Johnathan drives the Time Bandit into towering waves to haul the riskiest set of his career. Jake faces a potentially unstoppable magnesium fire, while Sig deploys evasive maneuvers to defend his catch.

Hampered by damage, Sig must outmanoeuvre an unknown captain to hold his ground; Jake allies with Wild Bill to make a critical deadline, but when Bill calls in his own favor, time runs short; Rick devises a strategy to ensure Jacob makes it home.

Stretched thin and desperately off-pace, Jared watches a loader tumble down the road; foreman Brad attempts to land his plane in choppy weather but is forced to shelter nearby; Barge Day arrives, but Brad has news for Jared that could destroy the season.

Investigate the Lunar Landing Research Vehicle that nearly killed Neil Armstrong in training. Some believe this proves why the moon landing is fake.
The Raneys arrive in Missouri to see a family that has just survived a tornado. Living in a crumbling cabin, they also have no clean water source.
A biologist and an Australian bushman form an intimate bond as they take on the Namibian desert. They search for scarce food while territorial baboons track them.

All-Star survivalists Wes and Suzänne take on Ecuador's relentless rainforest. Aggressive pumas, venomous snakes and constant storms make every step dangerous. Even these veterans are not prepared for the shocking news that shakes their challenge.

The frigid Montana wilderness pushes the survivalists to breaking point. As they struggle to work together, bears and aggressive moose circle their camp.

So while Mavis is on vacation, things get batty as Drac enlists his monster friends Frank, Murray, Wayne and Griffin to put Dennis through a "monster-in-training" boot camp!

p.t: The Adventures of Danny and the Dingo: Beardo's and Weirdo's
p.d: S5 E3Danny and The Dingo head to the Arctic Circle, but Dingo's mistake causes them to get split up in different countries. While waiting to meet-up with Danny, Dingo enters one of the crew in the World Beard and Moustache Championships in Norway.

S1 E10This episode of M80 has featured rider Brian Deegan. The General of the Metal Mulusha throws it down for all to see. Also check out a roadtrip to Oklahoma with Bryan Dowdy. Brian Foster is Blowin up and you know you want to check out this episode's token hottie.

S1 E11This episode features mulitipli time gold medal winner, Tommy Clowers, see him tear up the hills of Octotillo Wells, and at demos with his company, T-N-T. Drop in with Brian Deegan as he shows a fan the Mulisha meet one of Reche Canyon's secret weapons -- the Human Hater and see the best in the sport prepare for X-Games. BOOM!

S1 E6Focus on Rubén Fernández and Romain Febvre during the MXGP of Portugal and their drive to fight with the best riders especially Jeffrey Herlings on a mission to get his 101th GP win in Agueda! Experience the intensity and competitiveness of MXGP with an great magnifying look into the MXGP of Portugal!

S1 E6A week after Gracey's incredible 4th place at the World Champs, the team is back at Loudenvielle, ready to tackle another unpredictable UCI circuit track. Watch as they face the chaos together, rising to the challenge with strength and determination in this thrilling new episode of the series.

Field Productions is proud to present their eighth ski movie installment. With some of the best skiers in modern freeskiing, and a passionate film crew equipped with the best of HD cameras, this movie will both thrill and amaze you.

p.t: Drive Thru - South Africa - The Airline Strike
p.d: S3 E7The airlines go on strike, and the crew is left with its biggest decision. To settle on a solution is becoming more and more complicated as the trip moves on with no one person making a call. The crew elects Pottz to take charge, and the decision is made to drive down to J-Bay. This means one more night at Rudy's and another chance to surf out at the bluff.

p.t: Drive Thru - South Africa - The Bluff
p.d: S3 E8The crew wakes up to find a new swell in the water, and after a 5 star breakfast from Donnie and Benji, everyone is ready to get out to the water. Everyone scores great waves, but stories about 6 foot J-Bay pour in thru via cell phone. With all flights cancelled, the fastest way there means driving thru one of South Africa's more treacherous parts of the country.

The team travels to the Governor's Mansion in Hampton Falls in the state of New Hampshire, where there are rumors of hauntings caused by State Senator Warren Brown's illegitimate child, who was murdered, possibly at the State Senator's hands.

The Atlantic Paranormal Society travels to the city of Hartford in the state of Connecticut to investigate the house where prodigious American author Mark Twain lived and wrote, hoping to uproot some ghosts for the holidays.

TAPS travels to San Juan Capistrano, California to investigate the San Juan Capistrano Mission.
Renovations at Peoria Asylum in Bartonville, Illinois, are slowed down by strange occurrences, which are investigated by the team.
On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Cortland, New York to investigate The 1890 House.
On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Louisville, Kentucky to investigate one of the oldest operating steamboats in the United States, The Belle of Louisville.

When an illiterate farm boy starts asking why Christianity is true, no one seems to have answers. But after a twenty-year search for the foundations of the faith, he finds more than he ever expected.

p.t: Lost on a Mountain in Maine
p.d: Based on the best-selling book by the same name, Lost on a Mountain in Maine tells the inspiring true story of 12-year-old Donn Fendler, who becomes separated from his family by a fast-moving storm atop a treacherous mountain. For nine days Donn fights to stay alive as he attempts to survive the unforgiving wilderness of northern Maine without food, proper clothing, or the knowledge of how bad his situation really is. His disappearance sparks a massive search effort that captures national headlines and attracts hundreds of volunteers, including his own father who fears he may never see his son again.

Dot Conner is the world’s first “webtective,” a detective who uses the internet to solve mysteries, and in Dot’s experience there are no bigger mysteries than the questions she has about her Christian faith.

Peter talks with Dr Daryl Holmes from 1300 Smiles about the importance of moving from strategy and planning to executing. Peter and the team explore how by being willing to take steps, even if the plan isn’t perfect, valuable opportunities arise to adjust the plan to gain greater results.

Pastor Joseph Prince preaches dynamic messages centred on the pure gospel of the grace of God. His desire is to help believers understand grace and how greatly blessed, highly favoured and deeply loved they are by their heavenly Father.

Bruce Downes is The Catholic Guy. Bruce and his team will move, inspire and challenge you to live your life to the absolute fullest. No matter your age, situation or background, be prepared to laugh, learn and listen to what God is trying to say to you. Bruce travels Australia speaking regularly about his experiences in life and in the Church in a way that is both relatable and easy to understand. Bruce's message of power, impact, freedom and purpose is for anyone and everyone - for no matter where you are around the world today, God is never far from you.

A panel of women get together to share their lives, struggles, families, And the joy that occurs throughout their daily lives, And they also want to dig deeper to build a sense of community where they can work on relationships And their faith.

Scott Beck’s life hasn’t gone to plan. Now a high school janitor where he was once a basketball star, he faces family struggles and old regrets. When his former love Ryan holds open tryouts for her team, Scott sees a chance to chase his dream.

Since 1970 the Hour of Power has been reaching viewers from around the world. Originally founded by Dr Robert H Schuller, the program became the most-watched religious program in the world, reaching 17 million viewers. Now under the leadership of Bobby Schuller, Dr Schuller’s grandson. The congregation worships at Shepherd’s Grove Church in Garden Grove, CA. The program aims to provide spiritual principles and practices that can help people, as they become happy students of Jesus and live a life of meaning. To learn more about who they are in Christ through the process of formation, to belong to his family of believers and become a part of the community and to heal as they are loved and then love and help heal others through mission. Jesus Christ ushered in the Kingdom of God into our world through His death and resurrection. He invites everyone to be a part of this amazing movement by trusting and following Him. There is no fuller, richer life than the one that is lived in Christ.
We like to call it 'soul food'. LIFE TV uses creative illustration, real life stories and biblical teaching to encourage and help viewers discover a greater purpose to their lives.

God not only promises peace—He shows you how to keep it. In this message from his series Lessons from Philippians, Pastor Bayless reveals how your thought life determines whether peace remains or fades. You’ll discover why meditating on what is true, noble, and pure protects your heart, and you’ll learn the secret of being content whether facing need or abundance. When your trust is anchored in God, you can live independent of circumstances. Don’t miss this encouraging message that will help steady your heart.
Want to be bold in believing? Learn how to stir up your faith and release it in your life!

Katherine Ruonala shares a practical message of love and hope to the nations. Reaching across denominational walls, her ministry is used to spread the fires of revival and ignite a fresh passion in the hearts of believers to go deeper in their relationship with God. Katherine carries a strong prophetic and miracle anointing with many experiencing instant healing in her meetings.

Scott Beck’s life hasn’t gone to plan. Now a high school janitor where he was once a basketball star, he faces family struggles and old regrets. When his former love Ryan holds open tryouts for her team, Scott sees a chance to chase his dream.

p.t: Flying High for the Glory of God
p.d: Pilot and world champion runner Orville Rogers trained bomber pilots in World War II, flew the B-36 on secret missions during the Korean Conflict. Be inspired by the extraordinary life of Orville Rogers in this engaging documentary.
Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini shows takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.
Chef Michael Bonacini makes Pollo Alla to showcase the bold and filling flavors of the southern region of Basilicata, Italy.
Chef Michael Bonacini cooks four of his favorite dishes, and he shares secrets of the mountainous region of Molise, Italy.

Michael Bonacini draws inspiration from the Italian region of Valle d'Aosta, which is a mountainous area near France and Switzerland, as he demonstrates how to prepare several hearty dishes, including chestnut fettuccine.
Chef Michael Bonacini explores Tuscany's fine cuisine with four dishes: Many Mushroom soup with fried sage, Lamb Ragu over pici noodles, Porchetta-Style Duck, and a smooth Creamy Coffee Custard.

Host Michael Bonacini explores the Venetian region's bounty from sea to land — serving soft shell crab with tangy sundried tomato aioli, radicchio risotto, pancetta-wrapped snapper with pea mash, and a giant almond crumb biscuit to finish.

Puglia's lush landscape and large coastline characterize its cuisine. Michael explores its native ingredients through some of his favorite Puglian meals. First up, he serves crispy fried mussels, followed by tomato and burrata risotto.
Chef Michael Bonacini explores Sicilian cuisine, where simplicity meets intensity. He kicks off with folded flatbread with ricotta and fennel seeds, followed by broccoli and sausage rigatoni.

Host Michael Bonacini explores Lazio's grand culinary traditions, showcasing its Jewish influence with crispy Roman-style fried artichokes—as crunchy as a potato chip and the perfect way to kick off a meal.
Host Michael Bonacini dives into Campania's coastal cuisine, starting with a grilled Caprese salad from Capri, then serving bold flavors with a classic spaghetti puttanesca.

Chef Michael Bonacini explores Emilia-Romagna's iconic cuisine, making Mortadella Mousse on Modena Flatbreads, Tortellini in Broth, Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce, and Rice Custard Cake with Cherry Glaze.

Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes from the coastal region of Calabria. He prepares a light brioche with gelato, a spicy sausage and ricotta pasta, and a hearty lamb au gratin with peas and asparagus.

Chef Michael Bonacini explores Lombardy's luxurious cuisine, preparing stuffed squash blossoms with parmesan, anchovies and nutmeg, followed by a rich saffron Risotto Milanese—a feast for the eyes and taste buds.

Chef Michael Bonacini explores Umbria's lush landscape and seasonal ingredients. He serves fried spicy tomato flatbread, then highlights an Umbrian speciality—black truffles with light and fluffy gnocchi.

Appreciating island culture, Michael Bonacini explores the enchanting region of Sardegna and its exceptional cuisine. Michael begins his island feast with a taste of the sea through his antipasto of stuffed snails. Next, Michael prepares a luxurious and delicate lobster spaghetti, highlighting the fresh seafood of the region.
A young couple fear their 5 month old baby is the target of an evil spirit and Deanna Dunkle is attacked by dark shadows lurking in her home.
Carly Hall is haunted by evil spirits from her nightmares, a couple are attacked by a demon in their dreams and Ivan Latendresse is by ghosts that implore him to hurt others and take his own life.
Missie Hornbeck is tormented by terrifying apparitions, a teenager is horribly attacked by a demonic beast, and Rocky Primiani experiences frightening encounters with the afterlife.
Chris Houston is haunted by an evil ghost boy, a farmhouse is cursed by the presence of dark entities, and something dangerously demonic lurks in Bonnie Shukofksy's home.
Josie Haas is horrified to discover that the evil spirit of a bootlegger has followed her home, and Felicia Sills unleashes something terrifying when she unearths a Civil War era ring.
A monster stalks and attacks Frank Miller, a couple become the victims of paranormal activity that turns dangerously violent, and Holly Buffington is terrorized by the ghost of her ex-husband.
In Nova Scotia, a former naval officer sees five bright lights in the skies. He is able to see a cigar-shaped object behind the light, about 20 feet in length.
Grapple with a tormented soul and face a deserted hospital's resident demon.

Paramedic Ryleigh hunts a red-eyed dog demon and phantom master in an abandoned animal-testing lab. EMT Bret faces a satanic scene at a lonely farm, and officer Marco meets a dead mobster haunting his police station.

Inspect prison guard Bill’s scars from a brutal attack by the spirit of a long-dead prisoner. Revisit a terrifying nursing home haunting with rookie cop Anthony, and hear the spiritual words EMT Jose used to release the soul of a troubled apparition.

Experience corrections officer Alex’s encounter with the dark energy of a deceased prisoner seemingly bent on revenge. Probe a puzzling case with EMT Cory, whose patient seemed normal but died after an evil shadow rampaged through his room.
Officer Collins encounters paranormal activity at a penitentiary. Firefighter Hernandez sees a ghost in photos, sparking poltergeist chaos. Paramedic Chris finds a suicidal man's spirit in a motel.
Rookie EMT Kat meets the ghost of an elderly patient who carked it earlier in her shift at an isolated ambulance station. Firey Keith reckons he saved a bloke by talking his soul back into his body.
Deborah is disturbed when her critically injured boyfriend tries to break into the morgue. Plus, paranormal activity hits the dialysis clinic.
Big scares come in small packages—a ghostly girl follows a care-home housekeeper, disembodied footsteps trail a hospital balloon, and a pint-sized angel of death appears.

Chef Ramsay moves some of the team members around before the new groups are challenged to come up with a special salad dish, with the best meal being featured in a magazine; at evening service, things start badly and then get worse.

The teams are asked to create a dish made from ingredients chosen by the spin of a roulette wheel. The team who make the best meal are sent on a luxury trip to Las Vegas. Dinner service is a family event, complete with clowns and games, and the guests include members of Gordon's family as well as talk show host Jerry Springer. Can the contestants manage to impress their famous diner?
The teams must shop on a budget and prepare elegant dishes for four judges. The winners go sailing and dancing while the losers fumigate Hell's Kitchen.
Teams face a blind taste test. Can they identify the ingredients? Winners get a shopping spree and a slap-up dinner. A disastrous service sees Ramsay chuck multiple chefs out. Who's eliminated?

The seven remaining chefs tackle lobster, chicken and salmon, but each gets only five minutes alone in the kitchen. Winners score a shopping spree and top restaurant meal. At dinner service, diners choose between team menus. Who goes home?

Contestants have 20 minutes to make five portions of an amuse-bouche, judged by five local chefs. Winners lunch at the prize restaurant. At dinner service, sports stars Nomar Garciaparra and Mia Hamm drop in.

The remaining contestants must produce 80 portions of a lunch dish to serve from their own food truck. The person whose meal is the most well-received will be given a makeover while the others are left on cleaning duty. At dinner service, Paris Hilton is in attendance, but will her presence inspire the hopefuls to up their game?

The chefs are challenged to recreate a dish using only sight, smell and taste, and the losers must complete laundry duty; the chefs find their groove and manage to delight Ramsay with the smoothest dinner service to date.

Contestants create fusion dishes using ingredients from eight different cuisines. The winner scores lunch at top restaurant Spago. At dinner service, the hopefuls struggle on the pass. Who makes it to the final?
The two finalists cook five dishes at LA Market, where the winner will work. At their final dinner service, eight returning contestants help out, but there are no sous chefs. Who takes the crown?

New series of Gordon Ramsay's American cooking competition. 18 chefs compete for the prize of a head chef position at Gordon Ramsay Steak at the Paris Las Vegas in Paradise, Nevada. In the first episode, the contestants make a dramatic arrival at Hell's Kitchen before being split into teams for the signature dish challenge. When it is time for the first evening service, the teams have very different approaches, but there are struggles on both sides which lead to firm action from Chef Ramsay.

Gordon Ramsay's American cooking competition. In this episode, the contestants face a challenge involving scallops, with the winning team enjoying a yacht cruise and the losers having to clean and prep the kitchens. The losing team also get an unpleasant surprise from sous chef Scott in the form of a scallop smoothie. Evening service proves to be a disaster, but will an attempt by one team to rig the elimination succeed?

Teams cook for newly naturalized American citizens. Winners go on a safari in San Diego, while losers work the Ballona Wetlands. At dinner service, Ramsay calls in a former contestant for a pep talk. Who's eliminated?

Ramsay's teams rise early for a lamb challenge. Winners enjoy a day at the races, while losers face prep and a lunch of lamb testicles. Dinner service is a mess, with multiple chefs kicked out. Who goes home?

Teams face a Mexican challenge, cooking six dishes from 25 ingredients judged by experts. A misunderstanding sparks a blow-up, and a Mexican-themed dinner service sees multiple chefs kicked out of the kitchen.
A creative pair seek an artistic life and tour breathtaking bargain homes in Puglia, Italy. With an expert guide, they experience Italian countryside.
Erin's friend asks Ben and Erin to turn a dated, well-kept house into a Southern-inspired forever home, but surprises lurk beneath the surface.
After winning swimming pools, teams head outside to the backyard to create a Vegas-worthy entertaining oasis before Danny Amendola arrives to judge.
The hilarious, surprising, and bizarre behaviour that takes place after dark... because when the sun goes down, the neighbourhood gets wild.
Kamohai and Tristyn travel to Maui to help rebuild a home lost in the Lahaina fires, rallying a community to restore hope for a grieving family.
The Brothers must choose between a rookie investor struggling with a multi-million dollar flip, and a widow who's sitting on valuable real estate.
After devastating tornadoes damaged a young family's home, Dave and Jenny repair what was lost while also giving them the renovation of their dreams.
Comedians D'Arcy Carden and Sherry Cola explore California's High Desert rentals, including a lazy river resort and an artsy animal sanctuary.
A creative pair seek an artistic life and tour breathtaking bargain homes in Puglia, Italy. With an expert guide, they experience Italian countryside.
Two brothers and their mother team up to find a rundown beach house they can renovate and sell along the coast of Gulf Shores, Alabama.

p.t: My Lottery Dream Home: Where Are They Now?
p.d: David Bromstad hops in the time machine to catch up with past winners in Massachusetts and Cleveland.
After winning swimming pools, teams head outside to the backyard to create a Vegas-worthy entertaining oasis before Danny Amendola arrives to judge.
Erin's friend asks Ben and Erin to turn a dated, well-kept house into a Southern-inspired forever home, but surprises lurk beneath the surface.
A Dallas couple plans for the future when both their mothers will move in, and they're searching for a home for everyone in Tulum, Mexico.
After years of hard work, a couple makes the move from Alabama to roll tide in Maui, Hawaii.
1968 was a year marked by assassinations, a contentious presidential election, an escalating anti-Vietnam War sentiment, and more.
In the 17th century, as the smoke cleared from the civil war, the first celebrity criminals emerged. Mounted soldiers from the losing royalist armies turned to a life of crime, becoming 'Highwaymen'.
Charting the devastating impact pirates had during an age of colonial expansion.
Sam Willis explores urban crime, fraud and corruption in the eighteenth century and uncovers a fascinating rogues gallery of charmers, fraudsters and villains.
Athens, a small hamlet in its early days, was established on abandoned land in 3,000 BC, but it would be transformed into one of the greatest ancient cities in the 5th century B.C.
4th century B.C.: Alexander the Great sets out to transform a fishing village into the ancient world's most dazzling city; feast your eyes on a reconstruction of the city and its amazing buildings.
They fought their way through Europe, survived overwhelming odds, liberated concentration camps, and drank a victory toast at Hitler's hideout.
Revisit the rise and fall of the Inca Empire with new discoveries that challenge old myths of ruthless giants.

December 1914. After 5 months of war, both the Germans and the Allies have dug themselves in behind impenetrable lines. Faced with this siege, the soldiers will bring back into use an old weapon that they will modernize: mines, blowing up enemy fortifications from beneath...
Examine Qin Shi Huangdi, the man who united, and indeed gave China its name. His legacy includes the Great Wall and his astonishing tomb, guarded by the Terracotta Army.
Explore Clinton's transformative, controversial presidency. Learn about his upbringing and public career.
Discover the ancient Maya city of Tikal remodelled using computer graphics; inhabited for over a thousand years, this ancient city would encompass up to 12,000 structures and two million inhabitants.
Rome: the greatest city of the ancient world. We unveil the secrets of Roman architecture and the incredible talent of its builders; explore the Pantheon, Emperor Nero's palace, and the Colosseum.
Join host Matthew Burchette as he crawls through an iconic B-52 bomber, visits The Peace Garden State, and explores an active B-52 base.
Millions have flown in and out of Denver International Airport but few have seen this incredible operation from the inside out.

Holmes helps a Canadian military pilot and his wife complete their dream retirement home after a family friend said he could build the log house within their budget but leaves them high and dry with a home that isn't done and has cost them extra.

Sing the home-reno blues with Christina, whose contractor ran out on a $200K contract, leaving her with a mess. Watch the Holmes on Homes team untangle this nightmare to deliver the space and peace of mind the homeowner needs.

Mike and the crew tackle a leaky bathroom full of horrors left behind when a contractor walked off the job, helping homeowners Jo Jo and Heather. Along the way, Mike shares tips and tricks for building a luxurious loo as he makes it right.
Yetti and Andrew's negligent contractor left them with shoddy workmanship, zero functionality, a near poisoning and a court case. Mike steps up to build the kitchen they truly deserve.

Henry and Mandy's new-build home has a host of problems, including an icy guest room above the garage that's far too cold to sleep in. Mike steps in with a simple, satisfying fix for this shoddy construction.

Hiring a family friend as a contractor proves disastrous for Lynda and Joe, whose basement walkout has a bowed, cracked and badly patched wall straining their friendship. Mike's team rips it out and gets the job done right.
Homeowner Pat turns the windfall from a nine-year lawsuit against her home inspector into much-needed improvements, with Mike building a two-storey backyard deck to transform her outlook.

Head out on the hunt for investment properties with Mike and MJ, then discover a surprise that tests their father-son relationship and their business partnership. Stand back as Mike gets a lesson in treating his son as an equal.

Mike eyes a promising live-work-play retreat in a tourist hotspot, but MJ's wary of the commute to this diamond in the rough. Meanwhile, water issues threaten to drain the budget at the Country House.
Things look up at the Country House as a partial second storey takes shape. But at the River House, dangerous structural issues force Mike and MJ's crew to tear down the roof and second-floor walls.

A couple who recently had their bathroom remodeled with slate tile have noticed that some strange things are beginning to happen to their shower, so they turn to Mike Holmes and his crew for help fixing the repairing the problem.
Hope for a Christmas miracle as Mike and his team of elves take on a monumental job. Feel the love as he finishes Janice and Craig’s shell of a house.

Ingrid suffered an aneurysm after blowing her life savings on a botched reno. Mike steps in to help her daughter Natalie get it done right, with smart tips on writing contracts, choosing toughened glass and preventing leaks.

After his wife passed away, a man's home fell into disrepair when he closed off their bedroom, a part of an old addition that has no foundation or permits, and Mike rebuilds the space with work on a retaining wall, bathroom demo and asbestos removal.

Get your hands dirty with Mike and the Holmes crew when they take on Lali’s appalling, unsafe, unfinished kitchen revamp. Learn how a neighbour and so-called contractor swindled her out of $11K and took off, leaving her trust and her home in tatters.
During week two of Juiced, production captures O.J. Simpson's drunken descent as he revisits his past. O.J.'s girlfriend shows up on set with bruises.
With the final sketch in freefall, O.J. Simpson's volatile outbursts and signs of abuse rattle the crew. Tensions mount until the shoot implodes.
YouTuber Randy craves control and online fame but struggles to make real friends. Reality gets complicated when his fantasies begin to creep in.
Elizabeth Chambers investigates convicted conman Anthony Strangis. After meeting with his former wife, Elizabeth uncovers new alleged victims.
In Ohio, Judy and Jaden arrest Joseph, a bitter shoplifter. In Louisiana, Tina and Darnell pick up Trinity, a talented artist.
Judy and Jaden pick up a basketball dad who is supportive of all of his kids. Tina and Darnell arrest Travis, who isn't much of a conversationalist.

p.t: People Magazine Investigates: Surviving A Serial Killer
p.d: Amber and her children go into hiding from her abusive ex. At the same time, a serial killer prowls Dallas, gunning down people seemingly at random.
When teenager Harmahn Smith misses his curfew, his parents seek the police's help. His car and body are discovered - what happened to the 18-year-old?
April fills her TikTok with positivity, but when she opens up about mental health and marriage difficulties, her mum Jamie uncovers shocking secrets.
Elizabeth untangles the web of lies about Michelle Hadley, who was smeared by the media for stalking and harassing her ex-fiancé and his new wife.

p.t: American Detective With Lt. Joe Kenda
p.d: When a Minnesota woman dies after an arson attack on her home, Agent Fraik races to find the five-year-old girl she was babysitting.
When 55-year-old Monica Schmeyer is found shot to death in her living room, the peaceful people of Hanover, Pennsylvania are in a state of panic.

Twenty-seven-year-old Gretchen Fleming is figuring out her life while living in her hometown of Parkersburg, West Virginia. After a night out in town, Gretchen is last seen leaving a local bar with a mystery man and is never heard from again.
O.J. Simpson steps back into the spotlight with a hidden camera prank show. As producers push for shock and spectacle, footage reveals rising tension.
O.J. Simpson performs pranks for a hidden-camera show, exposing uneasy encounters and a carefully crafted persona that begins to crack under pressure.

The show goes on an island hopping adventure, making stops in the South Pacific, the mysterious Easter Island, Kangroo Island, Mackinac Island, and the beaches of Maui.

The show travels to Scandanavia to go biking, sking and fishing in Finland, exploring in the Aland Islands, taking part in adventure sports in Sweden, sightseeing in Norway, biking in Denmark, and finally visiting the Faroe Islands.
Charlie explores Pembrokeshire's coast, touring a famous hillside home, an estuary factory build, and a cottage set inside a castle ruin.
Charlie explores Devon's coastline, touring a cliff-side modern house, an estuary cottage, a 1960s-inspired hall, and a home with a gold sail.
Liesel rides horseback on the beach, tears through muddy swamps on ATVs and hikes El Yunque rainforest. Between luxury resort stays on Vieques, she discovers the island's tucker is the real star.
A world away from tropical island paradises, Hong Kong's famous for its skyscraper-packed skyline. Local girl Lesley Chiang's on a mission to show a different side of the city.
Dani Kristo showcases bonza Belize, with hundreds of kilometers of Caribbean coastline, the world's second-biggest barrier reef and ripper dive sites. Hard to say no, really.

Cyprus is the island of love beauty and in this episode of Luxe Travels, Host Sophie Ashley traverses the beautiful Mediterranean island to find out all about the must see and must experience spots in the birth place of Aphrodite!

This Luxe Travels episode explores one of Philippines 7000+ islands, and this particular island is voted by most travel publications to be the most beautiful in the world. We are of course talking about the island of Palawan.
Discover unknown corners of the world in our new show 'Beyond Borders'! Join our dynamic duo for an unforgettable journey filled with adventures culture and breathtaking views.

In this program we’ll meet two Michelin star chef, Alexandre Mazzia at his highly acclaimed restaurant in Marseilles. His daily challenge is not lack of inspiration, but to filter the massive influx of ideas that runs through his head.
Today we’ll visit the wonderful city of Paris and the restaurant of Eric Trochon - Solstice - an informal yet elegant restaurant awarded with a Michelin star.
In today’s program we will visit the star-chef Pascal Barbot, who became independent at age twenty-seven. Reservations at his 2 star Michelin-awarded restaurant Astrance are booked months ahead.
Daniel Barratier has worked with some of the best chefs traveling the world, now he’s back in his hometown, Annecy, the ”Venice of the French Alps were he invested in a true fine dining restaurant.

Jason and Tayler reconnect during a romantic stay in Lake Tahoe, but Jason struggles to keep his cool off-roading the Rubicon Trail. Precision is key, but does he expect too much of Tayler? Will those expectations shut them down?
This time the team are in Germany’s Rhineland where presenter Kay Nambiar hears his name being called out after becoming lost in the labyrinth of tunnels.
Thom's latest quest introduces him to Annalisa, who has the worlds loudest shout and to Brad Byers, who has the ability to force metal objects up his nose.

After crashing the Flying Kestrel at 148 mph, Jon and his team sift through the wreckage to find what went wrong. Determined to rebuild the 1935 Kestrel Riley, Jon sets his sights on a return to the track.
As the US no longer stands to be a global climate leader, China takes the mantle.
Earthrise sets off on a month-long journey around Antarctica to study the effects of climate change on the continent.
Earthrise assesses the depth of the crisis facing the world’s grasslands today, and explores some of the solutions that are being used to preserve them.

Music has the power to transport us back in time. Marty Music sat down with Nicole Richard, a neurologic music therapist, and professor from Belmont University to talk about how music affects our brains and stirs up memories.

p.t: The Chain: How The World Works
p.d: At a massive secondhand market in Ghana, the global fashion chain is traced through high-water cotton, stretchy oil denim, and bug-made silk.

p.t: The Chain: How The World Works
p.d: Inside a Boston maternity ward, the complex medical chain reveals how flowers become painkillers and one Pakistani town shapes global surgery.

p.t: The Chain: How The World Works
p.d: The New York City Marathon highlights our connected world, driven by 62-metal smartphones, microscopic microchips, and billion-dollar cloud bunkers.
Using a virtual scalpel, CGI strips the Eiffel Tower to its 17-foot base and peels back the boulevards to expose 180 miles of ancient quarries.
CGI animation dismantles this ancient mountain city, uncovering the genius Incan terraces, drainage systems, and stonework that survive seismic shifts
Los Angeles is stripped to its bones, revealing the high-tech base isolators, fault-line monitoring, and infrastructure built to survive the Big One.
Maria prepares for the Yummy Mummies of Melbourne to arrive. Lorinska and Rachel have a lot to dissect upon meeting soon-to-be-mom Maria.

Bendigo was one of the biggest gold finds in history. It's literally built on rivers of gold. Her grand hotels and theatres have played host to international celebrities… and some shady characters too.

Like its English namesake, Australia’s Newcastle also has a reputation for toughness and heavy toil, but it’s also a town with a unique identity, a rich maritime history and more than its share of eccentric characters.

p.t: The Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
p.d: A bully croc needs to be relocated in order to keep the peace. There’s the second installment of Tim’s quest to build a Tasmanian Devil insurance program at Devil Ark. And a rogue Death Adder is rescued from a bush garden.

p.t: The Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
p.d: A visit to the Northern Territory and Tim is at a croc farm to see how problem wild crocs are dealt with. Back at the reptile park he introduces us to dingo pups Daisy and Dan before returning to Devil Ark to see how work is progressing.

A tattoed pin-up model looks very out of place in a small outback town as she plans to marry her Aussie country boy. Also, a woman tries to lose weight after buying a wedding dress two sizes too small.
Using chocolate, the remaining dessert makers must produce their most swoon-worthy creation. The two weakest will head straight to the Zumbo Test, where a truly monumental challenge awaits them.
This time the couples travel to Sam and James's Instant Hotel located in beautiful Bryon Bay, a beachside town famous for its alternative lifestyle. But is the property location correct?

The day of Maria's baby shower has arrived, and the ladies get met with surprise after surprise, starting with the mother-to-be showing up in a horse-drawn carriage; back in Melbourne, Australia, model Lorinska attends a birthing class.

Dr. Lisa helps out Aleta and Mark’s family, who all have different concepts of the perfect dog. See what happens when she tries to find a pup who will jog with Dad, get along with the family cat, and please the kids.

Dr. Lisa is given the job of finding a new family member for Cade and Matthew, still grieving the loss of their beautiful dog, Callie. They want to find a new dog to join their family and help them heal the hurt.
Tonight, the contestants must create the ultimate kids party cake. Adriano Zumbo and Rachel Khoo won't be the only judges; they've called in some tough critics - kids!

Well known as the headquarters for generations of crime bosses, Carlton was also the epicentre of a creative outpouring in the 1960s and 70s that led to the emergence of a uniquely Australian film and theatre culture.

In 1941 sleepy, tropical Brisbane found itself the nerve centre for the Pacific War effort. The former convict colony found itself changing quickly, yet politically Queensland is the most conservative state in Australia.

p.t: The Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
p.d: Tim and longtime friend and fellow Reptile Park worker Obi put their lives on the line all in the name of love as they enter the cassowary enclosure. A call out to a local factory ends in another Peregrine Falcon rescue for Tim.
Rick Stein arrives in the region of Perigord, famous for black truffles, walnuts and decadent dishes cooked with duck.
James visits a rice farm in Valencia, reminisces at a favourite tapas bar of his, enjoys a fishing trip catching blue fin tuna, and introduces us to horchata.
It's week two of the competition, and there's no let up as the seven remaining young cooks face two more tough missions set by judges Poppy O'Toole and Big Has.
In Argyll, Rick meets a Michelin Green Star winning chef who cooks local and foraged ingredients. He catches langoustine with teacher-turned-fisherwoman.
Rick meets inventor James Dyson on his futuristic Lincolnshire farm, where robots help grow strawberries all year round. With some superb local sausages, he makes bangers and mash.

p.t: Eat Well For Less New Zealand
p.d: This week's family shop with a plan and know how to balance their books but with busy jobs and at least one very fussy eater, mealtimes are a constant struggle.
Gordon Ramsay hosts a fiery cooking competition in which the winner receives a head chef position.
The chefs are asked to create a cohesive three-course menu and prepare any dishes they want for a room full of diners; they'll need to win head-to-head culinary battles to acquire ingredients.
Mary and Andrew rendezvous in Montreal, at the Chateau Saint-Ambrose, a heritage building along Lachine Canal to meet eight cake connoisseurs from all across Quebec.
Paul builds a smoker from a household item. With the Bega Show near, he hopes his rooster will be up to scratch.
Eric Adjepong welcomes three of the country's most skilled salmon experts to prove their knowledge of fish can compete with Alex Guarnaschelli's experience.
Chef Mark and yoga teacher Loretta live in West London and have been together for 15 years. They're looking to find their perfect property near Estepona on Spain's Costa del Sol.
Gary and Jennifer from Northern Ireland, together 40 years, want to open a new chapter by buying a holiday home near the Spanish town of Vera.
Jonnie Irwin helps Steve, a chauffeur company owner, and Janice, an export co-ordinator, search for a home in Chiclana de la Frontera.
Shelly-Ann and her mum Umilta buy a home together but need space for togetherness and independence. Jonathan and Drew enlist their mum Joanne to help.

In Cornwall former skydivers Leigh and Richard restore a derelict 17th century flour mill. With no experience of building or restoration, and only 250k to play with, the battle to finish the mill becomes all consuming.
Chef Mark and yoga teacher Loretta live in West London and have been together for 15 years. They're looking to find their perfect property near Estepona on Spain's Costa del Sol.

p.t: A Place In The Sun: What Happened Next?
p.d: Our property experts catch up with house-hunters who bought their perfect place abroad, and get a glimpse of what their lives are like living in the sun.

p.t: I Bought It At Auction With Sarah Beeny

p.d: Shelly-Ann and her mum Umilta buy a home together but need space for togetherness and independence. Jonathan and Drew enlist their mum Joanne to help.
Jonathan takes on creating the ultimate additional dwelling unit and office space, while Drew experiences the downside of renovating a 100 year old house while building his bonus wellness wing.
Kirstie and Phil face a challenge finding a home for Helen and Paul in Worcestershire. With a 145k budget and mixed priorities, can they balance space, security, and budget?
Kirstie and Phil help Caroline and Nnamdi, moving from London to rural Lancashire with a 425k budget. With clashing tastes between period and contemporary, can they find a home that pleases both?
Phil and Kirstie help Olivier and Cheyvonne, who are back from France and facing sticker shock. With a 400k budget in East Devon, will they find a renovation project or face reality?
Kirstie and Phil assist fashionista sisters Natalie and Stephanie, who seek a trendy London home. With a 300k budget and mum's 100k boost, will they finally find a place that ticks all boxes?
Kirstie and Phil search for a family home and business combo for the Sprys, moving from Scarborough. With a 275k budget and only one business per 500 houses, can they find the perfect match?

Sue and Jan are desperate to sell their childhood home so they can help their father Robert live comfortably in a nursing home. Wendy and Dennis have the challenge of bringing this quaint cottage back to life.
Andrew invites Shaynna and Charlie to his home to relive Selling Houses challenges, greatest transformations and even snoop around his place.
Cameron Daddo and Pia Miranda unleash their adventurous side in the Maldives, the ultimate playground in paradise.

In the year of 75th anniversary of D Day, Alan Titchmarsh and his team head to Derbyshire to build an exciting garden for sprightly D Day Veteran Jack Parrott (98) and his wife of 68 years Margaret (94).
Angus spends a weekend at a stately home that boasts its own nightclub.

p.t: Long Lost Family: What Happened Next
p.d: Colin Deering - who first met his brother Bryan back in 2014 - starts out on a whole new journey to find out about his birth father, with consequences none of us could ever have imagined.
Andrew invites Shaynna and Charlie to his home to relive Selling Houses challenges, greatest transformations and even snoop around his place.

Sue and Jan are desperate to sell their childhood home so they can help their father Robert live comfortably in a nursing home. Wendy and Dennis have the challenge of bringing this quaint cottage back to life.
The blue lights are flashing as crews attend a cycling accident, and a man having a suspected stroke. The paramedics assist a woman who's fallen, and a baby who has had multiple seizures.
22-year-old motorcyclist Hazel is rushed in after a motorbike crash on a dual carriage, whilst 86-year old-John is in A&E with a suspected ruptured aortic aneurysm - a life-threatening condition.
A pensioner fights for his life after being crushed by a trailer. New air paramedic Tammy treats a man who's plunged 10 feet off rocks.
A freak accident in Cumbria leaves Richard fighting for his life. Horse rider Pat falls in Hampshire, and in Suffolk, medics treat motorcyclist Nigel for serious injuries in a night mission.
A family flee their home as fire breaks out. All the emergency services are sent to the scene. While queuing in a fish and chip shop, a woman collapses with a possible stroke.
Stanley Tucci explores how Italian immigration transformed the food scene in his adopted hometown of London; London is a culinary mecca where Italian food from every region gets a chance to shine.

At a clinic in the Yorkshire countryside, activist Jono Lancaster and a team of doctors come together to help provide care, free of charge, to people who society treats differently because of the way they look.

Bonaire's fringing reef is home to thousands of species of corals, fish and other marine animals. It is also home to a collection of stunning shipwrecks. These wrecks evolve over time, becoming artificial reefs that support an incredibly diverse marine habitat.

The Florida Keys is the first line of defence for the southern US. With a rich naval history and a coastal lifestyle, it's easy to believe locals who claim these waters are home to as many as 1000 shipwrecks.

The Bahamas is known as the underwater movie capital of the world. Hollywood has been coming here for decades, making epic movies and TV shows in its crystal clear waters, leaving behind a host of cinematic shipwrecks.

This island of the coast of Honduras stands out as a vacation resort hot spot. But it's not just the sun and sand that brings the tourists in droves. It's actually a diver's paradise with shipwrecks scattered from all corners of the the island.

Follow the first months of a newborn humpback whale's life in the waters off the Pacific Coast of Columbia. See how his mother nurtures him through sickness, supports his body, protects him under attack, and prepares him for an epic journey.

Travel deep into the Columbian rainforest, where it's mating season for one of the most clever monkey species in the world. Witness the most important time of year for male squirrel monkeys that have been bulking up to impress females for months.
Get to know South America's only bear species. Witness the shy and charismatic spectacled bear play, forage, and look for mates at the secluded Chaparri Ecological Reserve in Northern Peru.

Travel to Samburu, where matriarch Anastasia turns her elephant herd north after a local river dries up. Then, in Naboisho, see cheetah mom Kuleta evade a crafty pack of hyenas. Later, in Laikipia, check in on wild dog Phoenix and her new litter.

Discover the clever way elephants dig wells, and see the relief that comes with a sudden river-filling downpour. Mourn cheetah Kuleta's loss after lions kill one of her cubs, and get a front-row seat when wild dog Phoenix faces off with a hyena mob.

Trail Anastasia as her herd splits to protect two precious elephant calves, while Kuleta retakes territory for her remaining cheetah cubs. Join wild dog Phoenix's search for a new mate as the skies open up and rain begins to heal the parched land.

Look behind the scenes and meet the innovative teams working to preserve and protect Kenya's wildlife. Check out Save the Elephants' radio-tracking-collar system, a drone that monitors wild dog packs, and a local team of Maasai cheetah trackers.

Megan swallows her pride and asks for her job back at Wendigo Farms. Tammy's hot young date shows up at the barn uninvited. Allie briefs Mike on a drastic strategy for winning Tammy back.

Celebrate as Allie cashes in on a horse while Tammy shocks the barn by announcing her wedding is next weekend. Join a whirlwind dress-shopping spree and watch Megan take over Allie's lesson with Courtney—with less than stellar results.
There were always going to be days like this. Watch as an attempt to save the damaged tail of a puppy, a high-tech eye operation, and a dramatic birth push Dr. Scott to the limit.

Follow Dr. Scott as he performs a risky procedure to save a 14-year-old family dog, then travels to a working farm in the heart of London. Back home, a French bulldog pup suffers from a mystery disease.
A three-legged Labrador has an issue; Scott tries to determine why a two-year-old patient is walking like a senior animal; a chubby hedgehog begins a fitness routine.

A springer spaniel is brought to the clinic with a bone stuck in his throat; Dr. Brown sees a golden retriever with a disfigurement; a King Charles spaniel with a terminal illness is brought to the clinic to receive treatment.
Dr Chris needs to use all his detective skills to find out why the end of Zaza, a pygmy bearded dragon’s tail keeps mysteriously falling off.

Journey to Shamwari Game Reserve in South Africa with Dr Chris to take part in a surprising elephant contraceptive programme. Then check on a kitten with a life-threatening breathing condition and a motorcycle-loving pooch with a bad ear.
A hard-to-control bulldog undergoes a state-of-the-art operation; Dr. Brown takes a look at turtle that has wandered far away from its home.

A springer spaniel is brought to the clinic with a bone stuck in his throat; Dr. Brown sees a golden retriever with a disfigurement; a King Charles spaniel with a terminal illness is brought to the clinic to receive treatment.

Rudi the cat, a 21-year-old feline, heads to Dr. Scott's clinic to have a large mass removed from her ear; the owner of a diabetic Chihuahua receives bad news concerning their pet; a rabbit with large teeth needs medical assistance.

Assess the damage when Watson arrives with a slashed eyeball after a brawl with the family cat. See if surgery will fix a fox injured in a hit-and-run, then tear up at an emotional reunion with one of Dr. Scott’s cherished clients.
Watch a bromance develop as Dr. Scott helps a British bulldog get back on his feet again, then meet a young family worried about their labradoodle. Feel the deep bond between a man and his cat.

Check out Emma’s adorable orphaned patient before a moment of madness puts Archie’s future in jeopardy. Examine a German shepherd who is losing her mobility, then encounter some special babies at a wildlife sanctuary with Dr. Scott.

Deal with a terrier’s diabetes diagnosis and see how Dr. Scott help this ailing pooch through the toughest battle of his life. Experience an emotional reunion with Emma before the clinic bands together for an unforgettable emergency.

Special effects experts Adam Savage and Jamie Hyneman conduct experiments to try to determine if a person can become trapped in an airline toilet, if the biscuit bazooka really exists, and the truth behind the legend of the leaping lawyer.

Can material in your toilet bowl aerate when flushed, and waft onto your toothbrush?

Larry Walters attached something like 45 weather balloons to this lawn chair. One of his tethers broke and he shot straight up into the air and apparently went up to about 16,0000 feet.

Jamie Hyneman and Adam Savage find out if a rocket attached to a '67 Chevy creates a 350-mile-per-hour road warrior and then test a stomach-exploding theory by combining fizzy candy with soda. It's sure to be a blast!

In this episode, the Mythbusters attempt to answer some of their fans' questions about previous experiments. Located in the wild blue waters of the south-eastern Pacific, and ringed by one of the world's richest coral reefs, Cocos is a Holy Grail for divers and undersea explorers.

The islands of the Bahamas are a stunning nature-lover's paradise spread over more than 100,000 square miles of the Atlantic Ocean, about 150 miles from Florida's southeastern coast.
Hunters never know where the next meal will come from, but they must be prepared to find it. Investigate the weapons at the disposal of Africa's predators.
Snakes, spiders and scorpions are the kind of creepy crawlies many fear the most. In Africa, these species are refined predators.

Persevere with a mother crocodile as she struggles to survive and raise her young in one of Africa’s most seasonally volatile and unforgiving rivers, the Katuma. Endure hunger and danger as she guards her clutch with ruthless precision.

Sink your teeth into the bloodthirsty battles between stealthy Nile crocs and heavyweight hippos along Africa’s sun-scorched rivers. See why power is temporary, peace is fragile, and survival belongs to the resilient in these aquatic arenas.
Despite their considerable size, the giant offer can be remarkably difficult to find. Biologist Carolina Ribas sails through the Pantanal in search of them.

This small park makes a big difference to endangered animals. Offering sanctuary to some of the biggest and smallest animals on the planet, witness how species come back from the edge of extinction to reclaim their place in Africa’s wilderness.

Considered to be the most beautiful of the Cape’s protected areas, Kogelberg Nature Reserve has experienced minimal human interference. Discover the spectacular land and sea life flourishing in this unique botanical wonderland.

Join guide Jean du Plessis for his first summit attempt on Mt. Kilimanjaro to see whether climate change has eroded its snowy peak. Learn about the pinnacle’s five climatic zones and search for clues that its volcanic heart is rumbling back to life.

SG-1 investigates when evidence suggests that there are still Goa'uld hiding on Earth -- including a former System Lord.

The crew has an unexpected run-in with the legendary Jaffa of the Sodan, and a heated battle ensues. Mitchell is left wounded, but before he can recover he is abducted by different enemies who train him for a savage fight to the death.

The team stumbles upon a Goa'uld-human hybrid that has been abandoned in a laboratory and takes it to Earth, where extensive studies are carried out on the life form. The results of the experiments reveal it was created from Anubis's DNA.

After an SGC officer returns to Earth after unknowingly being infected with the Ancient Plague, the virus quickly spreads throughout the United States. Not wanting the Ori to gain control of the Milky Way Galaxy, Orlin yet again descends to help Carter find a cure.

With the Prior plague threatening all life on Earth, the team enacts a plan to apprehend the Prior who is the cause of the epidemic; the leader of the Jaffa is transformed into a Prior; Teal'c attempts to keep the Jaffa from following the Ori.

The team travels to a planet where aliens have learned to graft memories from one person to another. However, the mission to initiate trade talks is put in jeopardy when Colonel Mitchell is accused of murder and he vividly remembers committing the crime, leading the rest of SG1 to set out to clear his name. Starring Ben Browder.

A black hole causes the merging of alternative realities and leads to confusion at Stargate Command as multiple versions of the SG1 team return to the base. The event is bittersweet as the arrivals include some fallen allies whose faces they never thought they would see again. Starring Amanda Tapping and Christopher Judge.

Baal rises up against the Jaffa High Council's democratic ideology, and brainwashes some of the governing body's magnates in a bid to overthrow the regime. Mitchell finds out an old friend is dying, leaving him facing an important decision. Guest starring Cliff Simon.
Daniel is imprisoned on a world under the influence of the Ori, and the Prometheus is caught in a firefight when SG-1 tries to rescue him.
Off The Grid: SG-1 is captured on an alien world after a deal goes wrong. Plus, the planet's Stargate goes missing. Intergalactic action.

A crop of genetically engineered insects turns deadly, forcing the SG-1 team to destroy them before they and the visiting international diplomats becoming their next victims. Ben Browder, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, and Christopher Judge star.
Mitchell, Carter and Daniel become out of phase while experimenting with a powerful and ancient device.
Vala returns to Stargate Command to deliver startling news. The Ori have been steadily building their arsenal, and plan a crusade against their enemies very soon...
SG-1 travels to Camelot to find a device that can help them defeat the Ori. They investigate a library guarded by a hologram called the Black Knight.
Vala, still aboard an Ori ship, watches her newly born child quickly ages and is molded to lead the Ori army.

Hard Merchandise is forced to deal with its captain’s health issues and simultaneously take on one of its biggest fish fights of the season.

After buyers took a much-needed break to relieve their inventory and improve the health of the market, the fleet is back on the hunt for blue gold.

North Atlantic bluefin season nears the halfway point and prompts Ott family fishing vessel Bad Fish to join the hunt. Tim Ott, Sr. along with brother-in-law Chris Spike McGovern, fish alongside sister vessel Hot Tuna in the hopes of bringing home two paychecks for the family business. Meanwhile, new rivalries form within the fleet as boats scramble for their share of wicked tuna.
With the season in full swing, the fishermen fight to keep their focus on fishing despite personal challenges with family at home.
The Hard Merchandise races to catch one more fish before Dave's surgery.
The fish are biting, and the market is on fire, and the question isn't whether boats will hook up, it's who will catch the biggest bluefin of them all.

Hot Tuna shares baits and advice with nearby boats hoping for a big payday. Meanwhile, Hard Merchandise gets a late afternoon hookup and races the clock to make their catch. And up north, Pinwheel takes on a fish fight that forces them to work around a pesky obstacle. Who will prevail?

You can’t keep a good captain down as Hard Merchandise’s Dave Marciano returns to bluefin fishing after his heart procedure to prove that he’s still got what it takes to stay in the game. Meanwhile, fishing in Chatham with the majority of the fleet for the first time this season, Captain Dave Carraro of FV-Tuna.com must catch a big, high-quality fish to make the trip worthwhile.

The season is entering the home stretch, and five-time champion Dave Carraro looks to put the pressure on the rest of the fleet by fishing in Chatham to extend his lead. Up north, the Pinwheel bands together while captain Tyler Mclaughlin battles through illness to get back on the water and return to the hunt for Bluefin Tuna.

The window begins to close on the North Atlantic blue fin season as fish and paychecks get bigger and bigger. However, family fishing vessel Hard Merchandise isn’t celebrating. Dave Marciano faces the devastating loss of his father and to lift the family’s spirits they plan to honor their loved one with a giant blue fin tuna.

It’s a tight race with only five-thousand dollars separating the top six boats as the quota diminishes. As the fleet digs deep to catch as many fish as possible before the season comes to an end, which determined captain will take the lead? Can 8th place underdogs Wicked Pissah stage a comeback? And which boat will go the distance for that last crucial paycheck?
Rumors swirl around the fleet that the quota is almost gone, and that there may only be a few more days left to fish.
With nearly every boat in contention on the season's last day, each captain hopes to make the move that will earn them the title of the GOAT.

After a long winter, it’s bluefin season again in Gloucester, Massachusetts. The fleet is eager for a paycheck and it’s not long before they’re on the meat with jumbo tunas. With more catches than ever in Wicked Tuna history, the captains must decide whether to test their luck in Chatham or fish locally.
